a: Autovacuum keeps tables healthy; ANALYZE updates planner stats.
Seq scans are fine for small tables; indexes help selective filters.
Bitmap scans combine multiple indexes efficiently.
work_mem affects sort/hash operations; too high can OOM under concurrency.
Prefer PgBouncer transaction pooling for many app workers.
Prepared statements avoid re-planning and prevent SQL injection.
Index only active rows: WHERE deleted_at IS NULL.
Bloated tables/indexes waste IO; monitor and reindex as needed.
HOT updates avoid index maintenance when indexed columns stay unchanged.
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) shows IO and cache behavior.
